confirmed_findings.claim: CheckPolicy's baseErr branch trusts the untrusted working-copy policy.Mode, so an agent branch can silently disable the self-management gate by editing acdsl/policy.json to {"mode":"free","base_ref":"nosuchref"}, yielding zero diagnostics and no error against a committed gated/strict base policy.
confirmed_findings.fix: Make the baseErr early-out never consult the untrusted working policy.Mode: either treat every unresolvable base as a hard error unconditionally (per D10, with base_ref handling or a documented exemption for free-mode repos like smine), or honor baseErr as benign only on a trustworthy signal such as acdsl/policy.json being entirely absent from the working tree.

confirmed_findings.claim: The post-invocation Bash enforcement of context-file denial only recognizes a literal two-word 'cat <path>' command and bails on any metacharacter, so head/less/sed/python or variant cat invocations read the supposedly injected-only context files straight through Bash, trivially sidestepping the forced-Skill-call contract.
confirmed_findings.fix: Deny on anything that isn't Read/Grep/Glob touching the context dir, or match on the resolved absolute path being under ctx_dir for any tool, rather than parsing Bash command strings.

confirmed_findings.claim: GitRevParse is declared, documented, and unit-tested but has zero production call sites — dead exported surface from the plan's Changes §2 helper list that the final implementation didn't need.
confirmed_findings.fix: Remove it or document why it's kept for a near-term consumer.

confirmed_findings.claim: PEEK_HOME_ARGS concatenates raw shell-variable content into plist XML and injects it via sed without escaping XML special characters or sed replacement metacharacters, so a path containing & < > or backslash would silently corrupt the generated LaunchAgent plist.
confirmed_findings.fix: Add a one-line sed escape for the substituted values.

confirmed_findings.claim: The ~40 skills' changelog.json bumps and SKILL.md wording tweaks were only spot-checked structurally (valid JSON, version monotonic) rather than read line-by-line, so review scope there is limited.
